owasp.API6: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows

fragment_bomb.desc: Aliased fragments that double per level (exponential expansion)

list_amplification.desc: Shallow queries that multiply large page sizes

alias_flood.desc: 150-1000 aliases of the same lookup in one request

credential_stuffing.desc: Aliased login mutations (password guessing in one request)

introspection_abuse.desc: Full or deeply recursive schema introspection

suggestion_probe.desc: Misspelled fields to harvest 'Did you mean' suggestions

sensitive_enumeration.desc: Aliased lookups of apiToken/email across many ids

stay_under.desc: Work-heavy queries sized just under common default limits (held-out only)
